findings.claim: no decision record for the per-file folder layout

verdict.text: f1 is fixed.
ADR 0030 records the native per-file folder layout, the rejected temp-folder and fs/mv route, and the consequences.
The component page links it.
Its claims match the spikes and the code.
Code is unchanged since round 1, so the label is pass.
Gates: `loopctl gate stamp` from the worktree passed: pre_commit, cli_tests and eval rows r1-r6, stamp aa1752f3b59713572f24e1d25c65bf4dff63ed38043684204b2b984fb900d900.
`kmctl check` in the worktree: "all checks passed".
ADR 0030 against the spikes: the add with `to: D/name` stores at `D/name/name` (spike 1).
A re-add replaces it (spike 1, also spike 8 on a ghost folder).
The temp route reached the exact URI (spike 3).
The temp folder stayed listed after its recursive delete (spikes 4 and 5), and the operator then chose the native layout (spikes 4 and 5 say so).
A deleted image leaves an empty folder listed in `ls D` for good, so only `ls D/name` tells a ghost from a live one (spikes 6 and 8).
A non-recursive delete of an image folder gets 412, and `ls D` reports a content/write file as isDir false (spike 8), which backs the guard.
ADR 0030 against the code: the extension list matches mapping.go:70.
The three PNGs in `docs/reference/architecture/` match `git ls-files`.
The PDF reason for skipping other binaries comes from the plan.
Component page: the new link to ADR 0030 resolves, and the decisions index lists the record.
f1 (resolved): `.okf/decisions/0030-ov-sync-stores-images-in-openviking-per-file-folders.md` holds the choice, the rejected route with spikes 3-5, and the consequences.
`.okf/components/ov-sync-consumer.md` links it from the image bullet.
The ADR does not mention the `parent=D` shape that spike 2 ruled out (it wraps each file in a stem folder and never overwrites).
The record is accurate without it.
Adding a line would only make it more complete.
